A few things explained properly, rather than a long list. Most of this work was done
on GPU clusters, either for international student cluster competitions or as
research and internship work.

## Local LLM deployment and inference optimization

**The problem.** Running a 70-billion-parameter model as an interactive chatbot is a
throughput problem, not a modelling one. Naive serving leaves most of the GPU idle
between requests.

**What I did.** Built an end-to-end local chatbot around **LLaMA 3.1 70B**, served
with **vLLM** behind a **Gradio** front end on 4 NVIDIA H100 GPUs, then worked
through the inference path — continuous batching, kernel-level tuning, and memory
layout.

**Outcome.** **3× throughput increase** over the baseline deployment, with the whole
system running locally rather than against a hosted API.

`LLaMA 3.1` · `vLLM` · `Gradio` · `CUDA` · `4× H100`

## SC24 Student Cluster Competition — 3rd place

*Atlanta, US · November 2024 · the leading global HPC-AI student competition*

Three tasks over four days, on a cluster we configured and tuned ourselves:

- **MLPerf benchmarking.** Optimized **Stable Diffusion** for MLPerf on 4 NVIDIA
  H100 GPUs using **TensorRT**, tuning precision and kernel selection against the
  benchmark's accuracy constraints.
- **Mystery application — cat object detection.** Trained **YOLO11x** for a
  same-day object detection challenge, placing **3rd** in that task.
- **Reproducibility challenge.** Reproduced the findings of the *DataLife* paper on
  the 1000 Genomes Project — the task that did the most to convince me I wanted the
  statistical half of this education.

The reproducibility work became a peer-reviewed critique, now in press at IEEE TPDS
([DOI: 10.1109/TPDS.2025.3627428](https://doi.org/10.1109/TPDS.2025.3627428)).

`TensorRT` · `Stable Diffusion` · `YOLO11x` · `MLPerf` · `reproducibility`

## ISC High Performance SCC 2024 — 2nd place

*Hamburg, Germany · May 2024 · one of the top three global supercomputing competitions*

**The problem.** Take **Neko**, a spectral-element CFD application, and make it run
as fast as possible on a 10 × NVIDIA H100 cluster within a fixed power budget.

**What I did.** Profiled the solver to find where the time actually went, then
worked on parallel decomposition, communication patterns, and system-level tuning
rather than guessing at compiler flags.

**Outcome.** **18.5× speedup** over the starting configuration, and 2nd place
overall.

`CFD` · `parallel programming` · `MPI/NCCL` · `profiling` · `10× H100`

---

## APAC HPC-AI Competition 2023 — 1st place

*Sydney, Australia · February 2024 · against 21 teams from 17 universities*

**The problem.** Optimize inference for the **BLOOM** large language model across a
multi-GPU cluster.

**What I did.** Combined **tensor parallelism**, **DeepSpeed** inference
optimization, and **NVIDIA NCCL** collective tuning, measuring each change instead
of stacking them and hoping.

**Outcome.** **11.4× inference speedup**, and first place overall.

`BLOOM` · `tensor parallelism` · `DeepSpeed` · `NCCL` · `LLM inference`

## FourCastNet end-to-end deployment — 2nd place

*High Performance Application Competition 2023 · Hsinchu, Taiwan · against 8 teams
from 7 universities*

Deployed and ran **FourCastNet**, an AI-driven global climate model, end to end:
environment setup, multi-node training, inference, and visualization. Less a
single-technique problem than a test of whether you can carry a full AI workflow
from a bare cluster to a finished result.

`FourCastNet` · `multi-node training` · `full-stack AI workflow`
